name: identity_asset_ingest
title: Add an image or texture to FX Studio
description: Ingest an image/logo/texture from HTTPS or base64 into your account's asset library. Omit project_id for account authoring or supply an accessible Project for its account. Add returned asset IDs to a scene's settings.asset_ids to admit those exact bytes to the isolated scene runtime. A scene has no ambient network or account credentials.

project_id.description: Project public ID; this is the account boundary for the uploaded asset.

url.description: HTTPS image URL to fetch. Pass either url or data_base64, not both.

data_base64.description: Base64 image bytes, optionally as a data:image/...;base64 URL. Pass either data_base64 or url, not both.

kind.description: Use logo for a brand mark/wordmark asset; image for supporting imagery.

examples.label: Upload a logo for a new brand

asset.description: Account-scoped asset ref with asset_id, kind, content_type, sha256, and authenticated url.
